caption:
In this video, two Grandmasters of two different Shaolin lineages, including my own schools Shaolin Yijinjing Qigong lineage, can be seen demonstrating pyro-kinetic abilities. Such an attainment only becomes available to those who remain persistent and consistent with their neigong practice, spending many years toward simultaneously cultivating one’s health and internal life-force. 

In the first video, is a direct disciple of the well-known Shaolin Grandmaster Hai Deng, who was renowned for his ability to meditate while standing on a single finger, a skill otherwise known as Shaolin YiZhiChan. The internal cultivation skills (fagong) displayed by that specific lineage are phenomenal.

In the second video, the now passed Grandmaster Xuan Kong, the Shifu of my Shifu, Jiang Lianyuan, can be seen projecting his internal energy from a distance and causing a piece of paper to ignite. Several masters in our school possess the specific type of ability. As common as the masters of my school may make it seem, this indeed is actually a rare ability.

#yoga #awakening #qigong #kundalini #reiki
